task.title: Build a scrubber so recorded leagues can be committed
task.description:
## Why
The repo is public and its guard rejects anything that looks like a Sleeper id (17 to 20 digits), plus all of `cache/` and `out/`. Recorded leagues hold real ids, manager names and team names.

## Steps
1. Write a script that rewrites a recorded run: map every league, user, draft and transaction id to a short made-up id, consistently across files.
2. Replace manager display names, usernames, team names and the league name with made-up ones.
3. Leave NFL player ids and names alone. They are public and the engine matches on them.
4. Re-run the Python replay on the scrubbed inputs to produce the expected outputs, so outputs never contain real names.
5. Run `.github/scripts/public_data_guard.py` over the scrubbed folder.

## Done when
- A scrubbed recording replays to the same call, ledger and deal values as the original.
- The public-data guard passes with the scrubbed recording added to the repo.
